# Multi-Tier Web Application with CI/CD

## Project Overview
A responsive frontend web application demonstrating the concept of multi-tier architecture.

## Technologies Used
- HTML
- CSS
- JavaScript
- GitHub
- GitHub Actions
- GitHub Pages

## Application Tiers
1. **Presentation Tier:** User interface built using HTML and CSS.
2. **Application Tier:** Basic client-side interaction using JavaScript.
3. **Data Tier:** Demonstrated conceptually; database integration is not implemented.

## CI/CD
GitHub Actions verifies the required frontend files when changes are pushed to the main branch.

## Live Demo
https://dhruvranjan06-svg.github.io/multi-tier-web-app/

## Deployment
Hosted using GitHub Pages.

## Note
This is a frontend demonstration. An actual backend, database, and EC2 deployment are not yet implemented.
